title: How Should Transformers Encode Numeric Values in Electronic Health Records?
abstract: arXiv:2607.01391v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: How do we encode numeric values in transformer-based sequence processing, particularly in electronic health record (EHR) data? We systematically compare discrete, continuous, and hybrid value encoding strategies using synthetic arithmetic tasks embedded within real-world EHR data, as well as real-world clinical prediction tasks. Our study reveals trade-offs between numeric precision, optimisation stability, and architectural flexibility. We find that approaches that explicitly model value-concept interactions perform best on precision-sensitive arithmetic tasks when architectural constraints permit. Hybrid token-based approaches that retain numeric values but apply binning prior to projection provide a more robust and broadly applicable alternative, with the optimal number of bins following a simple empirically derived power-law in dataset size. translated_title: Transformer应如何在电子健康记录中编码数值？
translated_abstract: 在基于Transformer的序列处理中，我们应如何对数值进行编码，尤其是在电子健康记录（EHR）数据中？我们利用嵌入真实世界EHR数据中的合成算术任务以及真实临床预测任务，系统地比较了离散、连续和混合数值编码策略。我们的研究揭示了数值精度、优化稳定性与架构灵活性之间的权衡。我们发现，在架构约束允许的情况下，显式建模数值-概念交互的方法在精度敏感的算术任务上表现最佳。而保留数值但在投影前进行分箱的混合标记化方法则提供了一种更稳健且适用范围更广的替代方案，其最优分箱数量遵循一个简单的基于经验推导的、与数据集规模相关的幂律。在各类任务中，模型始终表现出可靠且“足够好”的数值计算能力。
tldr: 该论文系统比较了Transformer处理电子健康记录数据时离散、连续和混合三种数值编码策略，发现显式建模数值-概念交互的方法在精度敏感任务上最优，而投影前分箱的混合方法更为稳健通用，且最优分箱数与数据集规模呈幂律关系。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares discrete, continuous, and hybrid numeric encoding strategies for Transformers on EHR data, finding that explicit value-concept interaction modeling performs best on precision-sensitive tasks, while binning-before-projection hybrid approaches are more robust and broadly applicable, with the optimal bin count following a power-law in dataset size.
